source_issue.title: Cannot register HEAD request handlers in custom Express middleware

summary_markdown:
```markdown
## What this issue is about
This issue pertains to the inability to register custom `HEAD` request handlers in Volto's Express middleware due to a default handler that responds with a 200 OK and `Content-Type: text/html` for all `HEAD` requests. This affects the proper functioning of certain features, especially regarding files like PDFs or images.

## What needs to be done
We need to modify the server setup to allow custom `HEAD` handlers to function correctly. This may involve removing or conditionally applying the wildcard handler that currently captures all `HEAD` requests or reordering the handlers so that custom ones are prioritized.

## Helpful background
The default handler setup utilizes a wildcard (`/*`), which intercepts all requests. Although it serves testing purposes in CI, it interferes with metadata retrieval for tools and indexers that rely on accurate `HEAD` responses.

## Good first steps
1. Familiarize yourself with the [Volto documentation](https://6.docs.plone.org/contributing/volto.html).
2. Review the server configuration in `src/server.jsx` to understand how handlers are registered.
3. Consider exploring whether the CI utility that requires the `HEAD` handler is still relevant.
4. Create a plan to adjust the ordering or presence of the current handler as discussed in the comments.
5. Test your changes locally and ensure that they do not break existing functionality.
```
